description: maskSensitiveLogFields performs only shallow key matching on the top-level object. If a log entry contains nested objects (e.g., { headers: { cookie: 'raw-value' } }), the nested sensitive keys will not be masked. REQ-AUTH-010 states 'Masking applied at log serialization layer — raw values never reach log sink', which implies all instances of sensitive keys should be masked regardless of nesting depth.
